page.notes: The faint show-through text from the reverse page is ignored. Some entries are printed with a wrapped line break; the first line of the first entry is partly lost to a damaged ink margin, so "plum" is the visible tail of "Templum". The word "stroram" is printed as such (likely "ministrorum" with the printed error or a broken line). Several "p." references in the lines are clear. The catchword "ER-" is at the lower right.
